visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: XOR Instead of Searching for Every Number
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Each candidate number is searched in the whole array with a nested loop. Use XOR: values that appear twice cancel out, leaving the missing number. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: x ^ x is 0 and x ^ 0 is x. XOR-ing every index and every value (plus n) cancels each present number twice and leaves the missing one. It needs one pass and no overflow-prone sums.
